title: Agent guidance lifecycle operation input
description: Inputs for a bounded agent-guidance lifecycle query or mutation.

target.description: Workspace root whose guidance lifecycle is being inspected or changed.

guidance_id.description: Stable identifier of the guidance record to inspect or mutate.

expected_revision.description: Required current record revision for revision-guarded mutation.

expected_record_revisions_json.description: Serialized map of guidance identifiers to expected revisions for multi-record mutation.

reason.description: Human-readable reason recorded for the lifecycle transition.

instruction.description: Prescriptive guidance text used when creating, replacing, or splitting guidance.

replacement_guidance_id.description: Identifier of the guidance record that replaces the selected record.

merge_guidance_ids.description: Guidance identifiers to merge into one lifecycle record.

split_instructions.description: Prescriptive instructions used to split one guidance record into multiple records.

task_class.description: Task applicability class attached to promoted guidance.

scope_class.description: Scope applicability class attached to promoted guidance.

explicit_remember.description: Whether an explicit remember request supports promotion authority.

dry_run.description: Preview the lifecycle operation without applying mutations.
